exit 0
--- stdout
Generate the autocompletion script for liza for the specified shell.
See each sub-command's help for details on how to use the generated script.
Usage:
liza completion [command]
Available Commands:
bash Generate the autocompletion script for bash
fish Generate the autocompletion script for fish
powershell Generate the autocompletion script for powershell
zsh Generate the autocompletion script for zsh
Flags:
-h, --help help for completion
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
Use "liza completion [command] --help" for more information about a command.
--- stderr
